games.name: Terrible Mouse: The Disaster
games.desc:
Terrible Mouse: The Disaster is an asymmetrical survival game inspired by other games in the genre, such as Forsaken and Sonic.exe TD.


The game consists of two teams: survivors and killers.

The survivors' role is to survive and complete objectives on the maps to reduce the round time and escape.
The killers' role is to prevent the survivors from escaping.

(The game is in alpha, so bugs are likely.)

games.name: limbus game
games.desc:
Limbus game is not a serious combat game, you are gonna have a bad time if you think that

Controls:
LMB - Basic Attack
RMB - Special
1, 2, 3, 4 - Skills
F - Block
W+Q/S+Q - Front Dash/Backwards Dash
A+Q/D+Q - Side Dash
R - Combo Break (Under 30% block posture)
M - Selection UI
-Hold click on the id/character card to see their description explaining everything about them
-Click the top of the id/character card to use their support passive (max 2)
L - Settings
B - Emote/Sticker
-Hover your mouse to the statuses under your character to see what they do

Added 1v1 game mode.

All pitches thrown fast with no drag have slight increase in speed
Batter can now right click during swing to check their swing
In VIP Servers, say "bp on" to activate Batting Practice and "bp off" to turn it off
